label: plants
name: Plants Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR plant image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible plant type, structure, growth pattern, and environment.

labels.trees: A photo primarily showing one or more trees with visible trunks, branches, and foliage.
labels.flowers: A photo primarily showing one or more flowers or blossoms.
labels.grass: A photo primarily showing grass, lawn, or low grassy vegetation.
labels.shrubs: A photo primarily showing short, dense, woody plants with multiple stems.
labels.crops: A photo primarily showing cultivated agricultural plants growing in fields or rows.
labels.vines: A photo primarily showing climbing or trailing plants growing along the ground or on supports.
labels.moss: A photo primarily showing soft, dense moss growing on soil, rocks, trees, or other surfaces.
labels.ferns: A photo primarily showing ferns with divided, feathery, or curled green fronds.
labels.cacti: A photo primarily showing cactus plants with thick stems, spines, or water-storing structures.
labels.aquatic_plants: A photo primarily showing plants growing in, floating on, or emerging from water.
